aws_elasticsearch_domain.opensearch is deployed inside a VPC (it references module.aws_vpc and aws_security_group.opensearch_access), but it has no dependency on aws_iam_service_linked_role.opensearch. AWS requires the AWSServiceRoleForAmazonElasticsearchService service-linked role to exist before a domain with vpc_options can be created; on the first apply (or whenever var.create_iam_service_linked_role is true and the role is being created in the same run) the domain creation will fail because no dependency orders the role ahead of the domain. Add depends_on = [aws_iam_service_linked_role.opensearch] to the domain resource.

aws_eks_node_group.managed_ng has an explicit depends_on on aws_iam_role.managed_ng, but the node group already references the role via an attribute (the role is listed in implicit_deps), so Terraform already creates the role before the node group. The explicit depends_on is redundant and should be removed.
